_doc: #747/#771 what GET /api/terminal/selftest runs (TerminalDebugApi), each as its own /api/terminal/exec: a fresh login session's shell, with its exit code, stdout and stderr reported per check. EVERY check is `sh -c '<posix script>'` (#771): the login shell that receives it is fish, where POSIX syntax such as VAR=value or $(...) inside && chains does not parse, so the script is handed to sh whole; the script itself carries no single quote and no backslash, which is what makes that one quoting level mean the same thing to fish, bash and zsh alike (the testers enforce it). Tools: claude, goose and hermes each answer --version and one call that needs no network (claude --help, goose info -- its version and config paths, hermes config path); node, gh, git and zsh answer --version. Auth (#790), with no network and no value printed: `claude auth status` exits 0 only when claude is logged in (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from the Account, or a /login credentials file), and goose and hermes each find a provider key (OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the Account, else one in the tool's own file) -- so `--version passes but nobody is logged in` fails the selftest instead of hiding. Storage (#736): the login linked ~/emulated and ~/cloud-drive-shared-store and left no upstream ~/storage. Shared store (#771), in the FIRST repository under ~/cloud-drive-shared-store/git (alphabetical, any name): git status works although the FUSE mount reports a foreign owner (ab_cloud-terminal-store/gitconfig, safe.directory); a file is created, edited with sed -i and deleted; and a #!/usr/bin/env sh script written there runs as ./script although the mount is noexec (ab_cloud-terminal-store/noexec-shebang.c, preloaded). Both terminals carry this same list, cloud-termux and cloud-nix-on-droid: keep them equal. ac_cloud-termux/rootfs/verify-rootfs.sh runs every check in CI against a noexec, foreign-owned staged store. PTY (#797): the checks above all run over PIPES, and on 2026-10-03 every one of them was green on a phone where fish drew no prompt and a bare `claude` fell into --print (#795). The last checks run ab_cloud-terminal-store/pty-selftest.json's checks ON THE PHONE through pty-check (zsh, shipped beside the store at /usr/lib/cloud-store in both terminals): each opens a real pseudo-terminal (zsh/zpty: openpty, setsid, TIOCSCTTY -- a session leader on its own pts, the shape a typed session has) under this phone's proot, uid, SELinux policy and /dev, and runs ONE named check in it -- tty names the pts, stty reads the termios, termios2 issues glibc 2.42's TCGETS2 (termux only; the nix tree's own glibc already does), an interactive fish evaluates a typed line within 3 s of its spawn, and a bare claude reaches its TUI without the --print refusal. Measured on the S21+ before the fix: under the old proot the nix terminal failed all four with the owner's lines verbatim (`not a tty`, `stty: 'standard input': Permission denied`, no prompt, `Input must be provided`) while termux passed tty/stty and failed termios2 with EACCES. One check per name, so the selftest answer says WHICH pty property broke. The names come from pty-selftest.json and the tester requires every declared name here.
checks: sh -c 'r=$(ls -d ~/cloud-drive-shared-store/git/*/.git | head -n 1) && test -n "$r" && cd "${r%/.git}" && pwd && git status --short --branch --untracked-files=no'

sh -c 'r=$(ls -d ~/cloud-drive-shared-store/git/*/.git | head -n 1) && test -n "$r" && cd "${r%/.git}" && f=.cloud-selftest-$$ && echo one > $f && sed -i s/one/two/ $f && grep -qx two $f && rm $f && test ! -e $f && echo created-edited-deleted'

sh -c 'r=$(ls -d ~/cloud-drive-shared-store/git/*/.git | head -n 1) && test -n "$r" && cd "${r%/.git}" && f=.cloud-selftest-$$.sh && echo "#!/usr/bin/env sh" > $f && echo "echo ran-from-shared-store" >> $f && out=$(./$f); rc=$?; rm -f $f; test $rc -eq 0 && test "$out" = ran-from-shared-store && echo $out'
